# Bighorn Painting, Golden CO

> House painting company serving Golden, Colorado. Specialists in the city's three locally designated historic districts (8th and 9th Street, 12th Street, East Street), where most exterior alterations require a Certificate of Appropriateness from the Historic Preservation Board; we prepare those submissions. Also interior and exterior painting, stucco, kitchen cabinets, deck and fence staining, and foothills properties on Lookout Mountain and in Genesee. Rated 4.9 stars from 95 Google reviews. Free estimates, written 5-year workmanship warranty, fully insured.

Phone: 720-912-4676
Service area: Golden CO (80401, 80403) including downtown and the historic districts, Applewood Mesa, Sixth Avenue West, Lookout Mountain and Genesee.

## Key local facts
- Golden has three locally designated historic districts: 8th and 9th Street, 12th Street, East Street. The preservation program began in 1983.
- Most exterior alterations in those districts require a Certificate of Appropriateness (COA) reviewed by the Historic Preservation Board.
- The board meets the second Wednesday of each month; complete applications are generally due 4 to 6 weeks before the meeting.
- A COA-Compatibility application (covering alterations) carries no fee. Repainting in existing colors is generally maintenance, not an alteration.
- Golden requires a contractor license only for work that needs a building permit; painting alone does not normally trigger one.
- Exterior painting season: mid-May to early October in town, roughly mid-June to September in the foothills.

- [Historic home painting](https://paintersgoldenco.com/historic-home-painting-golden/): Painting historic homes in Golden, CO. We prepare Certificate of Appropriateness submissions and work to the city's historic district design guidelines.
- [Stucco painting](https://paintersgoldenco.com/stucco-painting-golden-co/): Stucco painting in Golden, CO. Breathable coatings chosen by permeability, cracks categorized before filling. Free estimates, 5-year warranty.
- [Cabinet painting](https://paintersgoldenco.com/cabinet-painting-golden-co/): Kitchen cabinet painting in Golden, CO. Degreased, sanded, bonding primed and sprayed to a smooth finish. Free estimates, 5-year warranty.
